reasons.title: You Own Everything, Always

reasons.title: One Point of Contact, Full Accountability
reasons.desc: No account managers playing telephone. The person you speak to is the person building your product.

reasons.title: Progress, Not Promises

reasons.title: AI-Native by Default

reasons.title: We Stay After Launch

About.introHeading: A small team building software the way we'd want it built for us.
About.introBody: AIVIK is a software engineering and AI automation company, based in Germany. We build custom software, automate workflows with AI, and set up the cloud infrastructure and data systems underneath, for founders and teams who want a direct line to the people doing the work, not a chain of account managers between them and their own product.

principles.title: You talk to the person building it
principles.desc: No account managers relaying messages. The engineer who writes the code is who you email.

principles.title: You own what you pay for
principles.desc: Source code, documentation, and IP transfer to you on day one. Nothing held back, nothing licensed back to you.

principles.title: German-based, GDPR-native
principles.desc: Not a compliance checklist added later. Data handling is built into how we architect systems from the first line of code.

principles.title: Small enough to move, structured enough to trust
principles.desc: A focused team, not a bench of juniors rotating through your project. Every engagement gets senior attention throughout.
